note: Guyana: a foreigner coming to work needs the Ministry of Home Affairs' landing permit for employment status (or the employment visa where a visa is needed), on a sponsor's contract and a vacancy advertised for three consecutive months; CARICOM's skilled nationals, musicians and artistes among them, come on the Skills Certificate (the csme list). No days without a permit.

sources.title: Ministry of Home Affairs (Guyana), Requirements for Landing Permit for Employment Status
sources.said: REQUIREMENTS FOR LANDING PERMIT FOR ... EMPLOYMENT STATUS ... The Vacancy that the applicant will be filling, MUST be advertised in the ... newspapers for three (3) consecutive months
